searched_but_not_found: English and Bangla web searches for diagnostic centres in each upazila (e.g. 'আক্কেলপুর/পাঁচবিবি/কালাই/ক্ষেতলাল ডায়াগনস্টিক সেন্টার', 'Akkelpur/Panchbibi/Kalai diagnostic') returned almost nothing local; the useful finds came from the DGHS facility registry, the Graduate General Hospital website and one Prothom Alo report. findoutdoctor (2023), prethibi (2020), whereindoctor (2024), bangladeshhealthalliance (2024), healthcenterbd and inhealthylife lists added no new diagnostic centres. prethibi's 'Joypurhat Clinic And Diagnostic Center' has no address or phone and was skipped; its other extra entries are government community clinics. daktarbook's Joypurhat list (12 doctors) and inhealthylife's centre pages (Tajul Islam, Al Shefa, Emu, Taqwa re-checked) had no doctors missing from our list. sebamedi has 0 doctors for Joypurhat centres. ePharma shows only 6 of 120 doctors without login. daktarachen showed no Joypurhat entries and doctorpara failed to load. Skipped because robots.txt disallows fetching: medsheba.com, hospitaldghs.gov.bd (DGHS licence PDFs), doctorsinjoypurhat.com, healthbdhub.com and the joypurhat.gov.bd upazila portals (hospital/clinic pages). Facebook pages were not used. No online doctor schedules were found for any of the newly found DGHS-registered centres. The web-search quota ran out before name-by-name searches for each new centre (e.g. Meditest, Oxigen, Doctors Lab, Lab Seven, Mollik, Naba-Ayat, Doctor Bari), so most new centres rest on the DGHS registry alone. Source note: 'DGHS registry' means the DGHS/MOHFW Facility Registry (the same database at hrm.dghs.gov.bd and hris.mohfw.gov.bd, so it counts as one source), filtered to Joypurhat (district_code=38), private, active: 88 rows. A registry row shows a centre was registered, not that it is open today; many 'next renewal' dates are 2019-2022. lat/lng were copied from the registry only where they fall inside the stated upazila, and placeholder coordinates were left blank.
